dog.description_text:
Huckleberry is a healthy and playful mix from Georgia. He has adapted to the NYC suburban life seamlessly.
He is well behaved and barks seldomly (mainly when there are strangers outside the front door which gives us a sense of safety). However, when friends or family are over, he will happily greet them with kisses.
He is potty-trained and is able to stay in his crate by himself for hours without any accidents. He sleeps well throughout the night whether it’s on his dog bed next to you or by himself on the sofa. He eats well and gratefully accepts treats.
He is perfectly fine chilling inside the house. However as soon as you get the leash, he will just sit down and wait to be taken outside. When outside, he is calm and relaxed around people and other dogs but if you release the leash, he can be the fastest dog in the park.
He loves to be cuddled and really appreciates whatever love you can give him. He loves the teenagers in the house and can be very playful if they are up for it.
My foster dog is good with: Teenagers and adults.
No small kids and it is better if he is the only dog in the family.
My foster dog is: Crate trained, House trained, Low Shed
3 Keywords for your pup: Loving, calm, appreciative.
Energy Level (1= calm, 10= high energy): 6
Walking Manners: Great. Pulls a little when he sees other dogs but will calm down if you hold the leash tight.
Appetite: Great!
Favorite Things: Cuddling and eating.
Commands: Will come when called, knows “sit,” “stay,” “lay down,” and “paw.”
dog.name: Huckleberry
